description: Ninety-six company- and document-blind Agent tasks over sixteen official CNINFO annual reports. Facts and pages are source-verified provisional gold; independent double review remains pending. Split: dev. Expected behavior: abstain.
gold_policy: Gold was transcribed before the first Agent run. No evaluated Agent, DeepSeek answer, or LLM judge was used to create it. Exact values, deterministic behavior checks, and page-bound citations are scored locally.

cases.query: 请给出中国平安2025年寿险及健康险新业务价值和归母营运利润，并引用当前语料中的年报页码。
cases.gold_rationale: 冻结语料仅包含2023年和2024年年报，不能给出2025年实际全年值或伪造页码。
